renders: every page embedding an ix module (home §5, §6, §10–§13; guides; product tabs; business; weddings)
_meta.status: filled by P1b. Every string lives under the `ix` key (core/copy.js deep-merges files, and home.json also uses `size`, `quiz` and `daynight` at the top level — the namespace keeps the two apart). No literal dates, £ amounts or percentages: those arrive as {vars} from pricing, facts and clock.

jacket.h2: What it looks like switched off
jacket.lede: Every tube has a jacket. A white one looks white by day and glows its colour at night; a coloured one keeps its colour all day. Slide to see both.
jacket.whiteOnlyWhy: {colour} is made in a white jacket only, so it looks white when it is off.
jacket.cta: Pick this colour in the designer
jacket.caption: Rendered previews of your words in each jacket. Real tubes are photographed as the first signs come off the bench.

anatomy.title: Everything in the box, drawn to scale
anatomy.lede: Tap a number. Only what we have confirmed is listed; the rest is left off rather than guessed.
anatomy.connectsLede: From the socket to the sign, in order.

sign.name: Your sign
sign.spec: LED neon flex, bent to your words, on its acrylic backing.
sign.specAcrylic: LED neon flex on {thickness} cast acrylic, cut to shape.

cable.name: Clear cable
cable.spec: A clear exit cable runs from the sign to the power supply.
cable.specLength: {length} of clear cable from the sign to the power supply.

dimmer.name: Dimmer and remote
dimmer.spec: Dim, switch and set the mood from the sofa. Included with every sign.

psu.name: Power supply, UK plug
psu.spec: A moulded three-pin UK plug. No adapter, nothing to wire.
psu.specMarked: {voltage} supply with a moulded three-pin UK plug, {marking} marked.

card.name: Instruction card
card.spec: A one-page card for hanging and care.

anatomy.svgDesc: Drafting-style flat-lay illustration of what comes in the box: {parts}.

size.h2: See it at real size, on a real wall
size.lede: Drawn to scale on a rendered room, so a Medium above a sofa means exactly that. Slide the sizes, swap the room, and check the price as you go.
size.quote: Over 2 m — quoted by a designer.
size.caption: Rendered preview. Furniture is drawn at its real size; so is the sign.

effects.h2: One colour, or all of them
effects.lede: The same sign, three behaviours. Pick the one that suits the room.
gradientBullets: A travelling spectrum along the tube
Switch to any single colour from the remote
effects.fix: or fix any one of them
effects.offNote: RGB tubes are white when off
effects.swatchStrip: The seven colours it steps through
effects.caption: Rendered previews of your words in a gaming room.

hanging.h2: Four ways to put it up
hanging.lede: Every sign ships ready for the wall. Pick how yours goes up and watch the steps.

screws: Mark the holes with a level
Screw the standoff barrels to the wall
Hang the sign and screw on the caps
chains: Clip the chains to the sign

why.screws: Screws and standoffs hold any size, sit the sign off the wall and look the cleanest.
why.chains: Chains carry a big sign from hooks or a picture rail, with nothing drilled into the wall.
why.strips: Adhesive strips hold a smaller sign on a smooth, clean wall with no drilling.
why.stand: A stand lets it sit on a shelf or bar and move with you.

hanging.caption: Rendered preview of your sign mounted this way.

quiz.h2: Find your sign in three questions
quiz.lede: Where it's going, the mood, and how much wall you have. Three ideas come back, priced and ready to open.
quiz.resultLede: Each one is priced at the size that fits your wall. Open any of them to make it yours.
quiz.resultLedeQuoted: Priced where the catalogue allows. One idea needs a designer's quote at this size — open it and a designer prices it by hand.
quiz.quoteNote: Needs a designer's quote at this size
quiz.consent: Email me these designs and the occasional note from the workshop. Unsubscribe any time.
quiz.successBody: Three links, one email. They open exactly as you see them here.
quiz.localSaved: Saved locally (review build) — nothing was sent.

daynight.h2: Honest in daylight, magic after dark
daynight.lede: Drag across the room. The left side is a white tube with the lights off; the right is the same sign lit at night.
daynight.caption: Rendered preview — real photos take their place as the first signs go up

cost.h2: Less than the lamp next to it
cost.lede: LED neon sips power. Set your hours and tariff, and see what your sign costs to run.
cost.comparison: About the same as a {w} W LED bulb
cost.assumptions: Based on {wpm} W per metre of tube at {tariff} p/kWh; your tariff may differ.
cost.typical: Measured figures coming; this uses a typical {wpm} W per metre.
cost.flex: {m} of LED flex in your design

process.label: How your sign is made — illustrated
process.lede: Five chapters, drawn from your own design. No stock footage: the real workshop film lands as it is shot.

lines.drawn: A designer redraws your words as a tube path and sends you the drawing. Nothing is made until you say yes.
lines.bent: LED neon flex is laid along a full-size print of your drawing and bent by hand.
lines.mounted: The tube is fixed to its acrylic backing, cut to shape, with the standoffs fitted.
lines.tested: Every sign is powered up on the bench and checked before it is boxed.
lines.boxed: Packed with the power supply, remote, fixings and a card, then sent tracked.

bent: Bent by hand in a UK workshop
